title: Notifications prompt
summary: The ask to turn on notifications. It is the entry notifications of chat-list-prompt (bipe-chat/bipe#894, MZ 2 Nov 2026): a card in the first row of the chat list, not a sheet. Allow opens the system permission; Agora não ends it for good on this phone.

isAsking.description: true while the system permission dialog is open.

allow.effect: Opens the system permission dialog. Allowed: push-registration registers this phone. Either way the card leaves the slot and does not come back.

notNow.effect: The card leaves the slot. It does not come back on this phone; the person can turn notifications on in notification-settings.

notes: Defined by registries/onboarding.json prompts, key notifications: trigger messageSent, slot true, primary to systemPermission, text dismiss. Generated BipeOnboarding gives the keys; the app does not hard-code them.

Condition: this account sent a message on this phone (kept on this phone once true), the system permission was never asked (push-registration permission notAsked), and the card was not dismissed on this phone. A phone that already allowed or denied never sees it.

Tier safety, first in its tier: without notifications the person misses replies. The slot rule of chat-list-prompt applies: it waits for the slot like every other non-preempting entry, and holds it until used or dismissed.
Before bipe-chat/bipe#894 this was a sheet over the chat after the first message. MZ decision 2 Nov 2026: every ask goes through one system, so the sheet is gone.
Move, do not rewrite: the prompt trigger logic is generated from the registry into BipeKit and libraries/bipe (BipeOnboarding).
